verdicts.reason: A: the 'Build Your Mix' CTA has moved to the very top, above the product and headline, so the reading order is backwards. The 'Flavours vary by region' legal line is now almost subhead size and competes with the headline. The ingredient pills come in very different sizes (WILD HONEY and ROSEMARY are tiny and illegible), sit on a ragged grid, and crowd the large logo in the bottom-left corner. B: the reading order is better (headline, then product, then CTA), but the pills are split into two groups at the top and bottom with very different sizes, the legal line is again oversized, and the logo has shrunk to a tiny, unreadable dot jammed in the corner, which is a brand failure. A keeps the logo intact and the pills together, so it is slightly less bad.
